name: Supernatural Artifacts and Relics
designRule: Every relic has a mundane presence and a bounded supernatural capability. The supernatural capability functions only for a wielder who meets its printed requirements and completes its attunement. Relic effects never expand through reputation, symbolism, or creative interpretation beyond their printed outcome.

relics.name: The Ashen Sun Reliquary
relics.origin: A consecrated vessel containing ash collected from a place touched by the original cursed solar signature.
relics.form: Palm-sized blackened reliquary with a shuttered crystal aperture.
relics.wielderRequirement: Human Investigator with a recorded Defining Conviction, or another character carrying an explicit anti-undead consecration capability.
relics.attunement: Spend one scene documenting the reliquary's history and state one sentence defining which undead threat the wielder refuses to permit.
relics.activation: Standard Action; open the aperture and name one visible target within Short range.
relics.effect: On a hit, roll 4 Aggravated damage dice against a Vampire, blood-fed undead, or creature explicitly vulnerable to the original cursed solar signature. Against other targets it produces harmless gray light and reveals whether they carry that exact vulnerability.
relics.limit: Once per scene. The light never counts as ordinary sunlight and affects only the named target.
relics.failure: On a failed activation containing a 1, the aperture cracks shut and cannot be used again until repaired with Reason + Fabrication against 3 successes.

relics.name: The Chalice of Last Vitae
relics.origin: A funerary cup made for a bloodline that preserved memory in the final blood taken before death.
relics.form: Dark silver cup whose interior reflects a room that no longer exists.
relics.wielderRequirement: Vampire with at least 1 Vitae and a recorded Remainder Bloodline or explicit blood-memory capability.
relics.attunement: Feed the chalice 1 Vitae while speaking the name of a dead person whose memory the wielder accepts responsibility for preserving.
relics.activation: Ten minutes of contact with fresh blood, preserved blood, or a blood-stained object.
relics.pool: Reason + Medicine or Awareness + Investigation against 2 successes.
relics.effect: Choose one: remove 2 Lethal damage from the wielder; preserve one blood sample indefinitely; or receive the final clear sensory memory carried by the sample, limited to one minute and only information the source actually perceived.
relics.limit: Once per scene. A sample yields its memory only once.
relics.failure: Gain 1 Hunger and receive one emotionally intense but factually irrelevant memory from the sample.

relics.name: The Crown of the First Hunger
relics.origin: A predatory blood-court regalia fragment designed to make appetite appear indistinguishable from authority.
relics.form: Thin iron circlet with inward-facing crimson points.
relics.wielderRequirement: Vampire with Resolve 3 and at least one rank in a blood-command, predation, or Vitae-control family.
relics.attunement: Wear the crown while refusing available blood for one complete scene.
relics.activation: Standard Action; address one blood-fed undead target within Short range that can hear or perceive the wielder.
relics.pool: Presence + Command opposed by Resolve + Composure.
relics.cost: Gain 1 Hunger whether the activation succeeds or fails.
relics.effect: On success, choose one command: Kneel, Release, Withdraw, or Speak One Name. The target performs that immediate action and then regains control. The crown cannot command self-destruction, permanent loyalty, or surrender of identity.
relics.limit: A target can be affected once per scene.
relics.failure: The target learns the wielder's current Hunger and gains 2 dice on its next social or predatory action against the wielder.

relics.name: The Moon-Silver Fang
relics.origin: A hunting blade forged from metal exposed to a vanished lunar covenant rather than ordinary terrestrial silver.
relics.form: Curved knife with a surface that shows a different phase of the moon to each observer.
relics.mundaneFunction: Melee weapon; Finesse or Force + Close Combat; 4 Lethal damage dice; Adjacent; Concealable.
relics.wielderRequirement: Shapechanger with a recorded Lunar Nation, Changing Form, or spirit-hunting capability.
relics.attunement: Carry the blade through one complete transformation and mark it with the wielder's blood without dealing damage.
relics.activation: Passive while attuned and wielded.
relics.effect: Against a spirit possessing a body, a shapechanger currently in Crisis, or a creature explicitly defined as corrupted by lunar or predatory influence, the blade's damage becomes Aggravated. Against all other targets it remains ordinary Lethal damage.
relics.limit: The blade never treats an ordinary person, animal, or untransformed shapechanger as a valid Aggravated target merely because the wielder suspects corruption.
relics.failure: When the wielder rolls a failed attack containing a 1 against a valid Aggravated target, gain 1 Instinct.

relics.name: The Skin of the Winter Wolf
relics.origin: A preserved war-form mantle whose original owner survived an impossible season by becoming less distinct from the storm.
relics.form: White-gray pelt that never melts accumulated frost.
relics.wielderRequirement: Shapechanger with Resilience 3 and access to Hunting Form or War Form.
relics.attunement: Sleep one full rest wrapped in the skin while exposed to natural cold.
relics.activation: Minor Interaction while transformed.
relics.effect: For the scene, the skin provides Armor Rating 2 that stacks with natural Shapechanger soak but not worn manufactured armor. It also grants exact immunity to ordinary environmental cold and 2 dice of resistance against supernatural cold that is not Aggravated.
relics.limit: The skin falls inert in Social Form and cannot be concealed as ordinary clothing.
relics.failure: If activation occurs while at the Instinct limit, immediately resolve the Archetype's normal Crisis procedure before gaining the armor.

relics.name: The Chain of Seven Names
relics.origin: A binding instrument made from seven links, each engraved with a name removed from a different occult archive.
relics.form: Short black chain that becomes cold near active pacts or possessing entities.
relics.wielderRequirement: Eldritch Binder with a recorded Binding Source.
relics.attunement: Assign one link to the wielder's Binding Source and speak a personal boundary the Source is not permitted to cross.
relics.activation: Reaction when the wielder would gain Intrusion, or Standard Action against one manifested extraplanar entity within Short range.
relics.pool: For active binding, Resolve + Noospherics opposed by the target's Resolve + Archetype Rating or equivalent.
relics.effect: Choose one: prevent 1 Intrusion that would be gained; or on a successful active binding, prevent the target from crossing one visible doorway, threshold, or marked line for three rounds.
relics.limit: The chain cannot reduce Intrusion below 0, erase an existing Breach, imprison an entity permanently, or bind the Binder's own Source beyond the stated prevention.
relics.failure: Gain 1 Intrusion and one unused link permanently darkens. When all seven links darken, the relic becomes inert until one is restored through a completed Source-specific obligation.

relics.name: The Nail from the Closed Door
relics.origin: A threshold fastener removed from a door that continued refusing entry after the surrounding building ceased to exist.
relics.form: Large square iron nail with no corrosion and no visible point.
relics.wielderRequirement: Eldritch Binder, Technomancer, or Human Investigator with an explicit sealing, containment, or threshold capability.
relics.attunement: Spend ten minutes defining one category of thing the wielder is responsible for keeping out.
relics.activation: Standard Action; press the nail into a doorframe, hatch, gate, breach, or marked boundary within reach.
relics.cost: Eldritch Binder spends 1 Pact; other wielders spend 2 Cohesion.
relics.effect: Seal the threshold for three rounds. Opening, crossing, phasing, teleporting, or remotely operating through it requires 3 successes on an appropriate Force, Security, Noospherics, or supernatural test. The seal affects both directions.
relics.limit: One threshold at a time. Removing the nail ends the seal immediately.
relics.failure: The threshold closes physically if possible, but the supernatural seal fails and every entity currently attempting to cross learns the wielder's exact position.

relics.name: Choir Bell of the Drowned City
relics.origin: A ceremonial bell recovered from a settlement whose population continued singing after submersion.
relics.form: Hand bell filled with dark water that never spills.
relics.wielderRequirement: Harmonic Mutant with a recorded Compact Remainder or resonance capability.
relics.attunement: Match and hold the bell's unheard fundamental tone for one uninterrupted minute.
relics.activation: Standard Action; ring the bell once.
relics.pool: Presence + Performance against Defense Difficulty for each chosen target.
relics.effect: Choose up to Archetype Rating targets within 5 meters. On a hit, roll 4 Disruption damage dice. A target taking at least 1 damage also loses its Reaction until the start of its next turn. The wielder may exclude known allies before rolling.
relics.limit: Once per scene. The sound propagates through water, hull, and ordinary walls but not an active null field.
relics.failure: The wielder takes 2 Disruption damage dice that cannot be soaked by the bell.

relics.name: The Glass Harp String
relics.origin: A single impossible filament taken from an instrument used to tune buildings, bodies, and treaties to the same resonance.
relics.form: Transparent thread stored around a bone tuning key.
relics.wielderRequirement: Harmonic Mutant or character with an explicit structural-resonance capability.
relics.attunement: Tune the filament to the wielder's voice, pulse, or instrument during one scene.
relics.activation: Standard Action while touching a structure, machine, restraint, or damaged object.
relics.effect: Choose one: repair 4 durability; deal 5 Lethal structural damage that ignores 1 ordinary Armor; reveal the direction of every major crack, void, or load-bearing weakness within 10 meters; or silence one ordinary mechanical vibration for one round.
relics.limit: The string affects unattended structures and objects, not living tissue, active characters, or identity systems.
relics.failure: The object emits a violent harmonic pulse. Everyone touching it gains 1 Exposure and the string cannot be used again that scene.

relics.name: The Brass Eye of the Radiant Axiom
relics.origin: An awakened lens built to distinguish an authentic operating principle from an imitation, disguise, or inherited ritual shell.
relics.form: Mechanical monocle with rotating brass script instead of glass.
relics.wielderRequirement: Technomancer with an Awakening Paradigm, or character with an explicit analyze-capability permission.
relics.attunement: Observe three different active technologies or powers and record one true limitation of each.
relics.activation: One action observing an active device, field, power, relic, or alien system.
relics.pool: Reason + Science or Reason + Noospherics against 2 successes.
relics.effect: Choose two facts: its power source; activation condition; current controller; target; remaining duration; one interruption that ends it for at least one round; or whether it is an original function, imitation, or disguised system.
relics.limit: The Eye reports only facts already true of the observed effect. It does not identify unknown creators, motives, or complete construction methods.
relics.failure: Receive one correct fact and gain 1 Feedback or 1 Disruption damage if the wielder has no Feedback track.

relics.name: Rosary of the Null Saint
relics.origin: A devotional chain associated with a person remembered only for repeatedly refusing supernatural authority.
relics.form: Thirty-three dull beads that cast no reflection.
relics.wielderRequirement: Character with Resolve 3 and a recorded Conviction, vow, personal boundary, or Identity Anchor.
relics.skillRequirement: No Skill requirement beyond the recorded identity condition.
relics.attunement: Name one supernatural command, compulsion, or identity claim the wielder refuses to obey.
relics.activation: Reaction when targeted by supernatural command, possession, identity alteration, or emotional domination.
relics.effect: Add 3 dice to the resistance test. If the effect permits no resistance test, reduce its duration to one round. If it would be permanent, suppress it for one round instead.
relics.limit: Once per scene. It does not protect against ordinary persuasion, legal authority, physical restraint, or consequences the wielder voluntarily accepted.
relics.failure: If the resistance still fails, one bead cracks and the wielder gains 1 Exposure. After three cracked beads, the rosary must be reconsecrated through a meaningful act consistent with the recorded boundary.

relics.name: Mirror of Unlived Lives
relics.origin: A black mirror that reflects choices the observer could have made but did not.
relics.form: Hand mirror whose reflection always reacts one breath late.
relics.wielderRequirement: Resolve 3 and a stable recorded identity.
relics.attunement: Spend one scene describing a decision the wielder accepts cannot be undone.
relics.activation: Ten minutes of uninterrupted reflection after a completed scene or discovered consequence.
relics.cost: Take 1 Disruption damage that cannot be soaked by the mirror.
relics.effect: Ask one question: What immediate warning did I overlook? Which person reacted differently than I assumed? Which object or route mattered more than I knew? What established fact would have changed my chosen action? Receive one truthful answer drawn only from established events the character could have perceived.
relics.limit: Once per operation. It cannot reveal future events, secret facts the character had no possible access to, or a perfect alternate timeline.
relics.failure: The mirror shows a convincing but explicitly unlived emotional outcome. The Moderator identifies it as nonfactual, and the wielder gains 1 Exposure.

relics.name: Lantern of the Unforgotten
relics.origin: A memorial lamp whose flame is fed by names rather than fuel.
relics.form: Small iron lantern containing pale script in place of fire.
relics.wielderRequirement: Empathy 2 and a genuine intention to identify rather than command the dead or missing.
relics.attunement: Add the full name of one dead, missing, copied, or erased person the wielder intends to remember accurately.
relics.activation: Standard Action; speak one name or describe one unidentified person whose trace may be present.
relics.effect: For three rounds, reveal visible outlines of memory residue, ghostly presence, identity copies, erased records, and places where the named person left intense emotional or noospheric imprint within 20 meters. The lantern distinguishes present, departed, copied, and dead traces but does not compel communication.
relics.limit: One named or described identity per activation.
relics.failure: Reveal the strongest unrelated residue in range and gain 1 Exposure.

relics.name: The Executioner's Mercy
relics.origin: A blade carried by an executioner who believed the last exercise of authority should be the refusal to misuse it.
relics.form: Broad dark sword whose edge appears blunt until a judgment is spoken.
relics.mundaneFunction: Melee weapon; Force + Close Combat; 4 Lethal damage dice; Adjacent; Two-Handed.
relics.wielderRequirement: Character with Close Combat 3 and a Defining Conviction limiting whom they may deliberately kill.
relics.attunement: State the prohibited category of killing and spare a defeated enemy when doing so creates a real cost or risk.
relics.activation: Passive choice after rolling damage with the blade.
relics.effect: Choose one: convert all uncancelled Lethal damage from the strike to Non-Lethal/Bashing; or, against a target explicitly convicted by the wielder's recorded supernatural judgment capability, convert the strike to 4 Aggravated damage dice before soak.
relics.limit: The Aggravated option requires a separate recorded capability establishing valid judgment. The sword cannot declare guilt by itself.
relics.failure: If the wielder deliberately violates the attuned prohibition, the blade becomes Ruined as a relic and remains only a mundane sword until the wielder makes meaningful restitution.

relics.name: The Ledger of Debts That Remember
relics.origin: A contract book whose entries persist after paper, institutions, and sometimes signatories cease to exist.
relics.form: Thin ledger with pages that remain blank until a genuine obligation is spoken nearby.
relics.wielderRequirement: Negotiation 3 and a recorded Debt, Promise, or Contract the wielder personally honors.
relics.attunement: Write one obligation the wielder accepts and one limit beyond which they will not enforce it.
relics.activation: One minute speaking with a willing participant about an exchange, promise, debt, or settlement.
relics.pool: Presence + Negotiation opposed by Resolve + Negotiation if the other party contests the wording.
relics.effect: On success, the ledger records one exact obligation, one exact consideration, and one exact completion condition accepted by both parties. Until completion, either signatory may open the ledger to learn whether the obligation is Unstarted, In Progress, Fulfilled, Impossible, or Deliberately Broken.
relics.limit: The ledger does not compel compliance, transfer ownership, create consent, or punish a breach by itself.
relics.failure: The ledger records the unresolved ambiguity. All participants immediately know which clause prevents agreement.

relics.name: Seed of the Black Orchard
relics.origin: A living relic from an ecosystem that grew medicinal organisms from grief, carrion, and remembered names.
relics.form: Large black seed with a pulse matching the nearest injured creature.
relics.wielderRequirement: Medicine 3 or Xenoculture 3 and willingness to feed the growth nonhuman organic matter.
relics.attunement: Plant the seed in dead organic matter and remain present through its first growth cycle.
relics.activation: Ten minutes planting the seed in at least Load 1 of dead organic material.
relics.pool: Reason + Medicine or Reason + Xenoculture against 2 successes.
relics.effect: Choose one growth lasting for the operation: Healing Pod removes 2 Lethal or 4 Non-Lethal damage from one willing living target after ten minutes; Shelter Canopy creates Environmental protection for six people in a 5-meter area; Filter Root purifies twenty liters of water or one room of ordinary airborne contamination; Grasping Hedge creates a 5-meter barrier with durability 8.
relics.limit: One active growth per seed. The growth cannot reproduce the seed or heal Aggravated damage.
relics.failure: The seed consumes the material and produces a harmless but unusable growth.

relics.name: The Chronophage's Pocket Watch
relics.origin: A timepiece recovered from an entity that fed on delays, missed appointments, and consequences arriving too late.
relics.form: Silver watch with a second hand that advances only when no one is looking directly at it.
relics.wielderRequirement: Awareness 3 and Resolve 3.
relics.attunement: Keep one exact promise at the precise time agreed despite meaningful inconvenience.
relics.activation: Reaction when a visible device, signal, triggered hazard, or ongoing nonliving process would resolve within 20 meters.
relics.pool: Reason + Science or Reason + Noospherics against 3 successes.
relics.cost: Gain 1 Exposure and take 1 Disruption damage that cannot be soaked by the watch.
relics.effect: Delay that one resolution until the start of the next round. Targets, costs, and choices are fixed at activation and cannot be changed during the delay.
relics.limit: Once per scene. It cannot delay death, a character's entire turn, an already completed effect, or an event lasting longer than one round.
relics.failure: The effect resolves immediately and the wielder loses their Reaction until the start of their next turn.

relics.name: Key of the Ninth Lock
relics.origin: A master key made for a prison whose final lock controlled whether a prisoner remained the same person after release.
relics.form: Nine-jointed key that rearranges itself near barriers and identity systems.
relics.wielderRequirement: Security 3 and a recorded principle governing access, privacy, or release.
relics.skillRequirement: Security 3; Noospherics 2 for identity or digital locks.
relics.attunement: Open one legitimate lock for its rightful owner and refuse one illegitimate request for access.
relics.activation: Standard Action while touching a physical, digital, noospheric, or supernatural lock.
relics.pool: Reason + Security against the lock's normal difficulty, maximum 4 successes.
relics.effect: On success, open, close, or place one Serviceable temporary bypass on the lock for three rounds. The key reveals whether the lock protects property, information, movement, identity, containment, or consent.
relics.limit: It cannot open a lock whose required authority is a unique living person unless that person consents or the wielder possesses a separate explicit identity-override capability.
relics.failure: The lock remains closed and its current controller receives the wielder's identity or exact physical description if the system can transmit it.

relics.name: The Bone Compass
relics.origin: A funerary navigation tool assembled from the remains of travelers who died while still trying to reach someone.
relics.form: Small compass whose needle is a finger bone etched with names.
relics.wielderRequirement: The wielder must know the target's name, possess a meaningful personal object, or carry a biological or identity sample.
relics.attunement: Carry the compass while successfully finding one missing living person through ordinary investigation.
relics.activation: One minute presenting the target link and naming the person or object sought.
relics.effect: For one hour, the needle indicates the direction of the strongest current trace of the target within 10 kilometers and changes behavior to indicate Living, Dead, Copied, Divided, or Absent. It provides no distance and cannot distinguish between multiple equally strong copies.
relics.limit: Once per target per operation. Active concealment or identity shielding may oppose with Resolve + Noospherics.
relics.failure: The compass points toward the location where the target's trace was strongest during the previous twenty-four hours.

relics.name: Ember of the First Hearth
relics.origin: A coal preserved from a sanctuary that remained a home after every wall around it was destroyed.
relics.form: Warm black ember stored in a cracked clay box.
relics.wielderRequirement: Survival 2 and at least one recorded group bond, touchstone, or protected community.
relics.attunement: Share food, shelter, and honest warning with at least one person who cannot repay the act immediately.
relics.activation: Ten minutes establishing a camp, room, vehicle compartment, or shelter no larger than a 10-meter radius.
relics.cost: Consume one ordinary fuel or ration supply and spend 1 Cohesion.
relics.effect: For one full rest, the area gains ordinary comfortable heat, light, and Environmental protection from weather. Up to six willing occupants who complete the rest recover 1 additional Cohesion and remove 1 Exposure. The ember also reveals the first hostile creature that crosses the boundary by flaring visibly.
relics.limit: Once per operation. It cannot function inside an area the wielder knowingly obtained by betraying the recorded group bond used for attunement.
relics.failure: The shelter remains warm and visible but grants no recovery or warning effect.

relics.name: Mask of the Empty Witness
relics.origin: A courtroom relic made for testimony that had to survive memory alteration, possession, and replacement of the witness.
relics.form: Featureless white mask with writing visible only from inside.
relics.wielderRequirement: Resolve 3 and a recorded commitment to preserve accurate testimony.
relics.attunement: Record one truthful account that materially harms the wielder's own interests.
relics.activation: Minor Interaction before observing or giving testimony.
relics.effect: For the scene, the mask records exactly what the wielder personally sees and hears. The record is immune to the wielder's later memory alteration and clearly marks every interval in which the wielder was unconscious, possessed, replaced, or unable to perceive. It grants 3 Identity Defense against effects attempting to alter the recorded testimony while worn.
relics.limit: The mask does not determine truth, read thoughts, or record events outside the wielder's senses.
relics.failure: If the wielder knowingly gives false testimony while attuned, the mask permanently records the contradiction and cannot be erased by its wearer.

relics.name: The Red Thread of Return
relics.origin: A relationship relic once used to lead copied, possessed, transformed, or displaced people back toward a mutually recognized identity.
relics.form: Two lengths of red thread that cannot be separated by more than the distance between bonded people.
relics.wielderRequirement: Two willing characters with a recorded bond to each other.
relics.skillRequirement: Both require Empathy 2; at least one requires Noospherics 2.
relics.attunement: Each participant states one true memory of the other that they agree should remain recognizable after change.
relics.activation: Reaction when either participant suffers possession, identity alteration, involuntary transformation, memory replacement, or continuity displacement.
relics.pool: The unaffected participant rolls Presence + Empathy against the effect's resistance difficulty.
relics.cost: Both participants spend 1 Cohesion if able; otherwise the acting participant takes 2 Disruption damage dice.
relics.effect: On success, the affected participant immediately recognizes the bonded person and the shared attunement memory. They may make one new resistance test with 2 additional dice or suppress the alteration's control for one round if no resistance is allowed.
relics.limit: Once per operation. Recognition does not prove legal identity, restore missing memories, or undo physical transformation by itself.
relics.failure: Both participants know the bond was invoked, but the alteration remains fully active.
